finalText:
All 4 tests pass now.

**Root cause:** `src/jobs/processOrder.js` acquired a pool connection but only called `pool.release(conn)` after `run()` succeeded — no `try/finally`. `src/handlers/api.js` already used the safe `withConnection` wrapper (which does use try/finally), so the API path was fine; the worker job path wasn't.

The worker.log timeline matches exactly: each `job orderNNNN failed: invalid order payload` lines up with the `[db] pool in-use` count ratcheting up one-by-one (2/5 → 3/5 → 4/5 → 5/5) and never coming back down, until the pool hit 5/5 at 02:06:30, then cascading `pool exhausted` errors, 503s in app.log, and finally the supervisor restarting api and worker-1 at 02:13:36.

Fix: wrapped the `run()` call in `processOrder` with `try { ... } finally { pool.release(conn) }`, same pattern as `withConnection`.
